hook: Chemical agents glowing in the dark revealed hidden human DNA inside a Philadelphia house.

sections.voiceover: On 417 W. Chew Ave., Philadelphia police and the FBI excavated large portions of the property during a search tied to missing women. What evidence was left behind?

Investigators carrying equipment out of a basement door

sections.voiceover: Investigators at 417 W. Chew Ave. found hidden human DNA. The FBI searched the Olney property tied to missing women. Philadelphia police recovered lab equipment from the basement.
